profile.name: Ayush Raj
profile.subtitle: Student • Builder • Developer • Creator • Explorer • Gamer
profile.bio: I’m into building things—whether it’s code, circuits, robots, AI systems, or physics simulations. This portfolio is where I document what I build, experiment with, break, fix, and learn along the way.

currentWork.building: Virtual Steering Wheel System • Ayulang Compiler

projects.title: Virtual Steering Wheel
projects.description: Control Euro Truck Simulator 2 using your phone as a steering wheel — tilt it to steer, tap buttons for gas, brake, gear shifts, indicators, and horn. Optionally add webcam hand/face tracking for a fully hands-free experience.

subsections.heading: Sensor Integration
subsections.text: Utilizing precision hardware like the AS5600 Magnetic Encoder Induction Angle Sensor for accurate rotational telemetry.

projects.title: SMART EVM
projects.description: A complete electronic voting system built with an ESP8266 microcontroller and a Windows desktop application.

images.caption: Custom dashboard vector icons for user-friendly voting interface

projects.title: XY Writing Robot
projects.description: A two-axis robotic writing machine that precisely moves a pen along X and Y axes to reproduce text, drawings, and geometric patterns from digital instructions.

projects.title: Mini CNC Plotter
projects.description: A compact computer-controlled CNC plotting system capable of converting digital paths into coordinated stepper-motor movements for drawing and engraving operations.

projects.title: AI Handwriting Plotter
projects.description: An intelligent handwriting system that processes handwritten or digital text, generates realistic writing paths, and sends the resulting motion data to a physical XY plotting robot.

projects.title: Atom-Lab
projects.description: An interactive scientific simulation platform for exploring atomic structure, particles, antimatter, matter states, and particle interactions through visual computational models.

projects.title: Bharat Railways
projects.description: A detailed Minecraft railway simulation project focused on Indian railway infrastructure, including locomotives, coaches, stations, tracks, signalling, overhead electrification, and railway operations.

images.caption: Language and Enviroment of the development

projects.title: Web Development Showcase
projects.description: A collection of web platforms and digital tools I have developed, including this very portfolio. This site operates as a fully static, JSON-driven content architecture running independently on GitHub Pages.

iotAndElectronics.title: Microcontroller Ecosystems
iotAndElectronics.description: Developing custom firmware and networking protocols using ESP8266 NodeMCU, ESP32, and Arduino boards.

iotAndElectronics.title: Hardware Modules & Transceivers
iotAndElectronics.description: Integrating NRF24L01 wireless transceiver modules, CH376S USB read/write modules, and various display/motor arrays into cohesive physical systems.

creativeWork.title: Tokyo Travel Poster Series
creativeWork.description: Aesthetic graphic artwork incorporating Japanese typography (未来と伝統が交差する場所).

creativeWork.title: Unpredictable Troll Face
creativeWork.description: A handmade troll face with exaggerated, uneven features and a mischievous expression. The bright colors, bold lines, and lopsided grin give it a funny and slightly chaotic personality.

creativeWork.title: Eiffel Tower | Paris
creativeWork.description: A hand-drawn illustration of the Eiffel Tower made using black pen and sketch pen. The fine details and simple monochrome style highlight its classic architecture and charm.

creativeWork.title: Tower Bridge | London
creativeWork.description: A hand-drawn illustration of the iconic Tower Bridge, created using black pen and sketch pen. The detailed lines and bold strokes capture the bridge’s classic architecture in a simple monochrome style.

creativeWork.title: Supra MK4
creativeWork.description: A drawing of a supra MK4, handmade and made with black marker and black pen.

images.caption: Supra MK4 inspired from 'The Fast and the Furious'

creativeWork.title: Supra MK5
creativeWork.description: A hand-drawn illustration of the legendary Toyota Supra MK5, created entirely with black ink pen. The bold outlines and detailed shading bring out the car’s aggressive design and sporty character.

images.caption: Supra MK4 inspired from 'The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift'

creativeWork.title: Nissan GTR Skyline R34 | 2Fast 2Furious
creativeWork.description: A hand-drawn illustration of the iconic Nissan Skyline GT-R R34, inspired by its famous Fast & Furious look. Created with colored pencils, the detailed shading and blue racing stripes bring out the car’s aggressive design and street-racing character.

images.caption: Nissan GTR Skyline R34 inspired from '2Fast 2Furious'

creativeWork.title: Kawasaki Ninja H2R
creativeWork.description: A hand-drawn illustration of the Kawasaki Ninja H2R, created entirely with a black ink pen. The sharp lines and detailed shading highlight its aggressive design and powerful racing character.

creativeWork.title: Sigma Gymrat
creativeWork.description: A hand-drawn Sigma Male illustration created entirely with black ink pen. Detailed hatching and cross-hatching add depth and definition, giving the character a bold, confident, and powerful look.

images.caption: Inspired to make because of being fitness freak

creativeWork.title: Rhinoceros
creativeWork.description: A hand-drawn rhinoceros created entirely with black ink, focusing on hatching and fine linework. The layered strokes bring out its rough texture, solid form, and natural details.

creativeWork.title: Inner Demon Unleashed
creativeWork.description: A black-and-white character illustration featuring a fierce expression, sharp horns, and detailed hair. Bold linework and shading give the character a powerful, intense look with a strong anime-inspired style.

creativeWork.title: NBA PlayBoy
creativeWork.description: A hand-drawn sketch of an NBA player playing basketball, capturing the movement and energy of the game. The bold lines and shading give the figure a dynamic and sporty look.

images.caption: Used to be a Basketball player

creativeWork.title: Footballers
creativeWork.description: A black-and-white pen sketch of children playing football, capturing their energy and movement. The dynamic poses and expressive lines give the drawing a lively and playful feel.

images.caption: Used to be a football player

workspace.description: This is my main development and engineering workspace, where most of my projects go from an idea to something that actually works. The dual-monitor setup lets me code, debug, research, and monitor hardware at the same time, while tools, components, and storage drives are always within reach for testing and flashing microcontrollers. It's basically my little engineering lab for programming, electronics, robotics, and experiments.
